dominant_frame: A release must choose between immediate speed and gradual safety.

ideas.text: Release to a small audience first.
Run a production-like customer premiere before release.
Deploy today after a rollback check.
Release gradually with an explicit expansion rule.
Use the real release path for the premiere and verify recovery first.
Check rollback, then release through the real path to a selected audience.
ideas.collision_reason: The first optimizes time while the second limits exposure.

ideas.text: Offer preview access through the existing production path without a separate environment.

novelty.observation_axis: Operational cost created by a separate preview environment.
novelty.relationship: Links customer preview access to the existing production path.
novelty.causal_model: Reusing the path removes environment drift while audience controls limit exposure.
novelty.control_boundary: The team controls audience selection but not final customer behavior.
novelty.falsifier: Discard it if the production path cannot isolate the selected audience.
novelty.irreducibility: It changes the delivery boundary rather than choosing an immediate or gradual release schedule.

reviews.but: It needs a verified recovery boundary.
reviews.build: Add a rollback check before release.

reviews.but: It can delay value without a clear expansion rule.
reviews.build: Expand only after observing the first cohort.

reviews.keep: Customers see the experience before broad release.
reviews.but: A separate environment can hide production failures.
reviews.build: Use the real release path and verify recovery first.

plateau.reason: All evolved ideas still depended on a separate preview or staged-release frame.

reality_checks.feasibility: Requires an audience control on the real release path.
reality_checks.evidence: The rollback path is documented but audience isolation is unverified.
reality_checks.cost: Uses the existing release path with limited setup work.
reality_checks.causality: Real-path exposure reveals failures hidden by a separate preview environment.
reality_checks.control_boundary: The team controls audience selection and rollback, not customer behavior.
reality_checks.risk: A targeting error could expose the change broadly.
reality_checks.falsifier: Reject if the release path cannot isolate and restore the selected audience.

reality_checks.feasibility: Feasible when staged targeting and rollback are both available.
reality_checks.evidence: Rollback is known; staged targeting remains unverified.
reality_checks.cost: Adds monitoring and staged expansion work.
reality_checks.causality: Smaller initial exposure limits the impact of a release defect.
reality_checks.control_boundary: The team controls cohort size but not defect occurrence.
reality_checks.risk: Weak expansion criteria can delay value or widen exposure too early.
reality_checks.falsifier: Reject if cohort boundaries cannot be enforced.

reality_checks.feasibility: Depends on selective access in the current production path.
reality_checks.evidence: No operational result yet proves selective access.
reality_checks.cost: Avoids a separate environment but adds access controls.
reality_checks.causality: Reusing the path reduces environment drift while access controls limit exposure.
reality_checks.control_boundary: The team controls access rules but not all downstream integrations.
reality_checks.risk: Shared-path errors may affect unintended customers.
reality_checks.falsifier: Reject if access rules leak in a controlled test.
reality_checks.decision: Most promising after an access-isolation experiment.
